## C. The automation layer — D-020, in dependency order

QA and Security are **not** steps here; they are section F, continuous. Only this is a sequence.

| | # | What | Who | Blocked by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `[~]` | **1** | Agent runtime schema: registry, runs, claimable queue, logs, realtime, cost | **S2** | **issued as `S2-08-agent-runtime-schema.md`** — not greenfield: `automations`/`automation_runs` (migration 28) already cover the *marketing* half, so S2 extends rather than duplicates |
| `[~]` | **2** | Privilege boundary for `apps/automation` | **S7** | **issued as `S7-03-automation-privilege-boundary.md`** — design-only ruling, parallel to 1 |
| `[ ]` | 3 | Orchestrator skeleton + **Accounting agent** (#1) | S5 | 1 and 2 |
| `[ ]` | 4 | Agent dashboards in the back-office (status/queue/logs, realtime) | S4 | 1 |
| `[!]` | 5 | Deploy surface: container, the two secrets, CI lane | S1 | 2 · **owner: Anthropic key** |
| `[ ]` | 6 | **Grow agent** (#2) | S5 | 3 |
| `[!]` | 7 | FastAPI endpoints for Lieferando / Wolt | S5 | 3 · **owner: platform API access** |
| `[ ]` | 8 | Ingredient / recipe / stock schema (food cost) | S2 | large — not before 3 ships |
| `[ ]` | 9 | **Warehouse agent** (#3) | S5 | 8 |
| `[!]` | 10 | **Sales agent** — IG/FB DM lead-gen + order intake | S5 | 3 · **owner: Meta app + Business verification + Messaging permissions** · a send transport (D-017) |
| `[—]` | 11 | **Quality agent** (computer vision) | S5 | deferred by the owner; no spec — do not scope yet |

**Step 2 is the real gate, not step 1.** `apps/automation/.env.example` needs
`SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`; `_deploy.yml:150` records that D-013 deliberately
stopped shipping both. Every app SHOSHO deploys today is anon-key only, so automation is the first
component to hold privileged credentials on the host. The boundary gets designed before the orchestrator
exists, or it gets retrofitted around a working one — which is the expensive order and the default one.
